about_short_description.short_description: Brightwheel is a software platform for preschools and childcare providers.

product.name: Childcare Management System
product.description: An integrated software platform for preschools and childcare providers to manage enrollment, billing, communication, and daily operations.

product.name: Billing and Payment Automation
product.description: A tool to automate tuition billing, payment collection, and financial tracking for childcare programs.

product.name: Parent and Staff Communication Tools
product.description: A communication platform enabling real-time messaging, alerts, and sharing of photos and milestones between staff and families.

product.name: Experience Curriculum
product.description: A digital curriculum system with lesson plans and developmental tracking aligned to early learning standards.

product.name: Center Operations Management
product.description: Tools to manage admissions, waitlists, compliance, health checks, and reporting for childcare centers.

product.name: Payroll and Staff Time Tracking
product.description: A system to track staff hours, manage payroll, and provide online access to pay stubs and tax forms.
